summary.text: Francisco Paulino is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 16th Essex District, which includes parts of Lawrence and Methuen, and has served since 2023.

The Legislature's committee listing shows him on the House Committees on Climate Action and Sustainability and on Intergovernmental Affairs and the Joint Committees on Bonding, Capital Expenditures and State Assets and on Revenue.

paragraphs.text: Francisco E. Paulino's official biography lists his profession as tax lawyer and business consultant, with two children.
It lists his education as a B.A. in criminal justice from Mount Washington College in 2012 and a Juris Doctor and tax LLM from Suffolk University Law School in 2016.
His career highlights include founding Madison Tax, LLC in 2013, serving as senior mortgage consultant at Insight Mortgage from 2017, and founding Madison Mortgage Inc. in 2019.
Earlier roles include administrative coordinator and therapeutic mentor at Lahey Clinic from 2010 to 2011 and crisis aid in the Lawrence Public Schools from 2011 to 2013.
He served on the Lawrence School Committee from 2016 to 2018.
